subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should this PR land as a scoped embedded-runtime `sessions_spawn` mitigation while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92271 remains open for gateway loopback, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native spawn coverage, or should merge wait for one shared work-spawning policy seam?
rationale: The patch is a valid scoped bug fix, but it deliberately chooses a partial fail-closed boundary across fallback delegation surfaces, and automation cannot choose that product/runtime scope for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
options.body: Land the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard now and keep the canonical issue open for the explicitly uncovered gateway, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native surfaces.

options.title: Require Shared Seam First
options.body: Hold the PR until the same fallback completion-announcement policy is wired through all OpenClaw work-spawning surfaces that can re-delegate work.

options.title: Pause For Codex Ownership
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether the Codex-native `spawn_agent` follow-up must be owned upstream before any OpenClaw-side mitigation lands.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: Land the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard now and keep the canonical issue open for the explicitly uncovered gateway, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and authored the cross-harness review that defines the unresolved scope question.
